state.question: Assess Copper Storage's reported battery dispatch. I need the following measured result: Its measured September round-trip efficiency after auxiliary consumption.
state.conclusion: Copper's battery began commercial dispatch in September.
state.gap: Its measured September round-trip efficiency after auxiliary consumption.

candidates.title: Copper Storage: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Copper Storage, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of its measured September round-trip efficiency after auxiliary consumption.

candidates.title: Copper Storage: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Copper Storage's strategy in battery dispatch, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.title: Copper Storage: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: Copper Storage settlement meters supports a dated assessment of its measured September round-trip efficiency after auxiliary consumption.

candidates.title: Copper Storage: the operating record
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Zara Finch's Dispatch's dispatch on Copper Storage, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Copper Storage: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: Copper Storage features in a field guide to battery dispatch. The worked example draws on a separate setting: a consumer review compares battery dispatch in a handheld game console.

candidates.title: Copper Storage: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Copper Storage's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.
